roles.cloud: Cloud operations engineer. Independently uses AWS to operate cloud workloads, investigate operational issues and maintain reliable infrastructure.
roles.reporting: Operations reporting analyst. Prepares operational reports, maintains data quality and uses SQL to support business reporting.
roles.governance: Cloud governance lead. Guides and governs other people's use of AWS across teams, establishing cloud operating policies and standards.
roles.unrelated: Pastry chef. Prepares and bakes pastries, develops dessert recipes, decorates cakes and manages kitchen food hygiene.
roles.coordination: Business operations coordinator. Coordinates operational work, tracks tasks, maintains procedural documentation and compiles status updates for teams.
roles.dataQuality: Data quality administrator. Maintains accurate business records, investigates missing or inconsistent data and prepares data quality reports.
roles.support: Application support analyst. Investigates software incidents, analyses operational logs, maintains support documentation and reports service performance.
